source: Every Surge XT 1.3.4 patch (factory and third-party) from https://github.com/surge-synthesizer/surge at release_xt_1.3.4, measured by scripts/surge_catalog.py on one probe note: see that script for the probe and the words. transpose: semitones to play a patch that sounds an octave off its key at the written pitch. wheel and macros: what the mod wheel and each routed macro move, with the depth.

origin.license: Surge XT is GPL-3.0-or-later. The patches come with it from its repository; a patch that states a licence in its own metadata keeps it, given as its "license" here (78 of the 3,008, each CC0). No patch is in this file: only its id, path, size, hash, designer, category and name, the labels of its macros and the destinations and depths of its routings, read from the patch, and this project's measurements.
